title: Hierarchical roleset and attribute bindings design for RBAC v2
creator: Marco Alvarez
description:
Purpose: design a backwards-compatible RBAC v2 model that unifies hierarchical resource ownership with attribute-based bindings (ABAC-lite) so teams can express fine-grained admin policies without exploding role cardinality. This ticket covers the canonical role/role-set representation, resource namespace inheritance, delegated admin scopes, the permissions matrix mapping to actions, how SSO/SAML group mappings will translate to rolesets, and audit-log hooks to surface decision context for SRE/Compliance.

Goals:
- Provide a compact roleset schema: role definitions + bindings that reference static principals, SAML groups, and attribute predicates (e.g., org=acme AND env!=prod).
- Support resource hierarchy inheritance with explicit deny/override at child namespace level.
- Define the permissions matrix as a first-class artifact (CSV/JSON) used by the runtime to produce allow/deny decisions and by the Console for UX and drills.
- Ensure audit logs capture the decision path (role, binding, attributes, cached evaluation, fallback) for post-incident review.
- Map SAML/SCIM user/group assertions into rolesets via configurable mapping rules and transformation hooks.
- Provide migration adapters for current RBAC v1 users, with a soft dual-enforcement period and telemetry to identify unmapped permissions.

Scope (what this ticket includes):
- Schema for Role, RoleSet, Binding, AttributePredicate, ResourceNamespace, PermissionEntry.
- High-level runtime contract for evaluation: request -> policy resolver -> decision + audit context.
- Console surface: permission matrix editor + namespaced preview + SAML mapping UI wireframe.
- Audit log format additions and storage schema notes for increased fields (decision_trace, binding_id, attributes_evaluated).
- Migration plan: scanning tool, best-effort automated mappings, and a rollback strategy.

Out of scope:
- Enforcement SDKs (separate ENG ticket).
- Deep ABAC expressive engine (we limit predicate grammar to AND/OR/not-equal/comparison for speed).
acceptance_criteria: Schema review accepted by security and platform (PR merged)
Runtime evaluation contract documented and example request/response added to API docs
Console permission matrix wireframes reviewed by Design + Product
Migration tool prototype that scans existing role assignments and suggests target mappings
Audit log shows full decision_trace for a sampled set of requests and is queryable in Console
design_decisions: Adopt a roleset-first model: roles describe permission sets; bindings attach roles to principals or predicates
Support three binding kinds: principal (user/service), saml_group, attribute_predicate
Inheritance is opt-out at namespace level: children inherit unless explicit deny entry exists
Evaluate predicates at request time with caching keyed by principal+namespace+predicate-hash; cache TTL configurable per tenant
Audit logs will include a condensed decision_trace with reference IDs to avoid PII leakage; full evaluation trace stored in internal long-term audit storage
During migration, default unmapped permissions will be placed in a temporary catch-all roleset marked 'legacy-mapped' to avoid immediate denial
progress_updates: 2025-01-30: Initial schema draft completed and posted to Confluence (link below). Asked Security to review predicate grammar.
2025-02-04: Design sync with Product and Console; Product requested 'namespaced preview' to help tenants visualize effective permissions.
2025-02-07: Proof-of-concept predicate evaluator completed (Go). Microbenchmark shows additional 0.7ms median on critical path when caching is warm.
2025-02-11: Security review feedback: restrict predicate operators to prevent regex or expensive ops; require approval for any expansion. Action: add approval gating and feature flag.
2025-02-14: PR #4278 created for schema and smoke tests. Console wireframe v2 posted; Design asked for colorblind-friendly matrix encoding.
notes_for_engineering: Implementation should favor fast-path evaluation for the common case: principal binding present and top-level namespace. Predicate evaluation only when no direct binding found or when binding includes attribute_predicate. Keep the evaluation contract deterministic and idempotent; add feature flags for predicate evaluation to enable staged rollout.
migration_plan: Stage 0: inventory existing assignments and generate suggested mappings. Stage 1: run in 'audit-only' mode where RBAC v2 emits decisions but does not enforce. Stage 2: enable enforcement for low-risk namespaces. Stage 3: full enforcement and retire v1. Telemetry collected throughout to track user-facing denials.
open_questions: What is the maximum acceptable predicate evaluation latency before fallback to cached role?
How do we present overlapping bindings to Console users so they can understand effective allow vs deny?
What retention period for full evaluation traces is required by Compliance?
